events.description: Large-scale collective violent unrest: dense crowd of yellow-vested protesters confronts riot police in Paris streets; police deploy shields, batons, tear gas (f12–f16), and water cannon (f12–f16); chaotic movement, smoke, and sustained physical engagement persist across frames.

verification.reason: Definition of 'Riot' requires collective violent unrest—not mere protest or isolated incidents. The sequence shows coordinated mass confrontation, state force deployment, and prolonged disorder across multiple locations and tactics, satisfying the category. All listed candidates fall within this continuous event; merged accordingly.

events.description: Mutual physical combat between individual protesters and police officers: officers swing batons and push with shields while protesters actively resist, grapple, and strike back (e.g., f3–f5, f9–f11).

verification.reason: Visible reciprocal force: f4 shows an officer striking a person who is upright/resisting; f5 shows baton mid-swing toward an engaged protester; f9–f11 show shield pushes and hand-to-hand contact with both sides exerting force—meeting 'Fighting' as mutual combat. Candidate 8 (f17–f19) lacks reciprocity and is excluded.

events.description: In heavy smoke (f17–f21), individuals in yellow vests are prone or crouched near a police vehicle while others (including uniformed personnel) appear to restrain or apply force without effective resistance; e.g., f17 shows a person bent over another near a van, f18–f21 show figures immobilized in smoke with hands near heads/backs.

verification.reason: Frames f17–f21 show vulnerable individuals (prone/crouched, obscured) with force/restraint applied without visible reciprocal action—consistent with 'Abuse' (aggression against helpless victims). Occlusion reduces confidence; f4 (candidate 3’s start) shows active resistance, so not abuse—thus evidence limited to f17–f21, but interval must overlap all source candidates (t_start=5.0 retained per rule, though visible abuse begins at 17.5 s).

events.description: A water cannon vehicle sprays a high-pressure jet across a street, dispersing people including individuals in yellow vests; the scene shows coordinated crowd control amid protest-like activity.

verification.reason: Images f4–f10 show a police water cannon actively deploying against a crowd (including visible yellow-vested individuals), with smoke/mist and dispersal behavior consistent with riot control during civil unrest; this meets the definition of 'Riot' as collective violent unrest involving state response.

events.description: An armored vehicle advances through a burning barricade while groups of people in yellow vests assemble and maneuver large wooden barriers; smoke, fire, and coordinated movement indicate collective violent unrest.

verification.reason: Frames f0–f9 show an armored vehicle pushing through a flaming obstruction with visible smoke and debris; frames f10–f23 show multiple individuals in yellow vests collectively erecting, adjusting, and abandoning large wooden structures near fire and smoke, consistent with riotous barricade construction and confrontation—not isolated protest or accident. The continuity across frames supports a single ongoing riot event spanning the entire visible interval.

events.description: A dense crowd of yellow-vested protesters confronts a line of riot police in helmets and shields; individuals raise fists, shout, and press against the police line, with no visible weapons or sustained violence but clear collective unrest and tension.

verification.reason: The scene shows large-scale, organized confrontation between protesters and state forces, with text overlay stating 'It quickly escalated into a wider anti-government movement', consistent with riot definition (collective violent unrest); though no overt fighting is seen, the sustained pressure, raised fists, and formation indicate unrest beyond peaceful protest.
